content: Who spoke the words of Deuteronomy to all Israel in the wilderness?
explanation: He spoke east of the Jordan. “These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan” (Deuteronomy 1:1, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses says, “Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is…”
explanation: There is only one true God. “Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.” (Deuteronomy 6:4, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses says to love the LORD with all your heart, soul, and what?
explanation: Jesus called this the greatest commandment. “And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.” (Deuteronomy 6:5, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, to whom did Moses tell parents to teach God's words diligently?
explanation: Talk about them at home and on the road. “And you shall teach them diligently to your children” (Deuteronomy 6:7, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses tell Israel to write God's words?
explanation: They should see them every day. “Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.” (Deuteronomy 6:9, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses says man does not live on bread alone, but on what?
explanation: Jesus quoted this when tempted. “man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.” (Deuteronomy 8:3, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, what food did Moses remind Israel God gave them when hungry?
explanation: Their fathers had never known it. “and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat” (Deuteronomy 8:3, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, what did Moses say did not wear out during forty years in the wilderness?
explanation: God cared for every need. “Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.” (Deuteronomy 8:4, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses tells Israel to be strong and courageous, for God will never do what?
explanation: God goes with His people. “He will never leave you nor forsake you.” (Deuteronomy 31:6, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, whom did Moses call before Israel and tell, “Be strong and courageous”?
explanation: Joshua would lead them into the land. “Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous” (Deuteronomy 31:7, BSB)

content: At the end of Deuteronomy, which mountain did Moses climb to see the promised land?
explanation: God showed him the whole land. “Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo” (Deuteronomy 34:1, BSB)

content: At the end of Deuteronomy, God let Moses see the promised land, but what could he not do?
explanation: Moses died in Moab. “I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.” (Deuteronomy 34:4, BSB)

content: How old was Moses when he died, as told at the end of Deuteronomy?
explanation: His eyes were still not weak. “Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died” (Deuteronomy 34:7, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy's Ten Commandments, whom are we told to honor?
explanation: So that your days may be long. “Honor your father and your mother” (Deuteronomy 5:16, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, after reminding Israel He brought them out of Egypt, what does God command first?
explanation: God alone deserves worship. “You shall have no other gods before Me.” (Deuteronomy 5:7, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, which day did God tell Israel to keep holy?
explanation: It was a day of rest. “Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy” (Deuteronomy 5:12, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses say Israel had tested the LORD?
explanation: Jesus quoted this verse when tempted. “Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.” (Deuteronomy 6:16, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, what did Moses say Israel had lacked during forty years in the wilderness?
explanation: God was with them. “The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.” (Deuteronomy 2:7, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, why did God say He did not choose Israel?
explanation: They were the fewest of peoples. “The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples” (Deuteronomy 7:7, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses promises Israel will find God if they seek Him with all their what?
explanation: God is found by those who seek Him. “you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.” (Deuteronomy 4:29, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, how long did Moses say he stayed on the mountain to receive the stone tablets?
explanation: He ate no bread and drank no water. “I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.” (Deuteronomy 9:9, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, what happened to the first stone tablets of the law?
explanation: God wrote the words again. “the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke” (Deuteronomy 10:2, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, what wood did Moses use to make the ark for the new tablets?
explanation: The tablets were placed inside. “So I made an ark of acacia wood” (Deuteronomy 10:3, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, how were Israelites told to treat the poor and needy?
explanation: There would always be poor in the land. “that is why I am commanding you to open wide your hand to your brother and to the poor and needy in your land.” (Deuteronomy 15:11, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy's law, who should get a sheaf of grain forgotten in the field?
explanation: God blesses the generous. “It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow” (Deuteronomy 24:19, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, after setting life and death before Israel, what did Moses urge them to choose?
explanation: So they and their children may live. “Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live” (Deuteronomy 30:19, BSB)

content: In the Song of Moses in Deuteronomy, what does Moses call God, whose work is perfect?
explanation: God is solid and faithful. “He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just.” (Deuteronomy 32:4, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses says the eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are what?
explanation: God holds His people up. “The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms.” (Deuteronomy 33:27, BSB)

content: When Moses died, why was Joshua filled with the spirit of wisdom?
options: Moses had laid hands on him
explanation: Israel then obeyed him. “Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him.” (Deuteronomy 34:9, BSB)

content: After Moses died, how long did the Israelites grieve for him?
explanation: They mourned in the plains of Moab. “The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days” (Deuteronomy 34:8, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, how many days' journey is it from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea?
explanation: Israel took forty years instead. “It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.” (Deuteronomy 1:2, BSB)

content: In which year of the wilderness journey did Moses proclaim the words of Deuteronomy?
explanation: It was the eleventh month. “In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month” (Deuteronomy 1:3, BSB)

content: From Mount Nebo, Moses stood on the top of which peak facing Jericho?
explanation: God showed him the whole land. “to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho.” (Deuteronomy 34:1, BSB)

content: According to Deuteronomy, what does no one know about Moses?
explanation: God Himself buried him in Moab. “and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.” (Deuteronomy 34:6, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, how did the LORD know Moses, unlike any later prophet?
explanation: No prophet rose like Moses. “whom the LORD knew face to face” (Deuteronomy 34:10, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, how many times a year were Israel's men to appear before the LORD?
explanation: At three great feasts. “Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God” (Deuteronomy 16:16, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy's law, what must you build around the roof of a new house?
explanation: So no one falls from it. “you are to construct a railing around your roof” (Deuteronomy 22:8, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, Moses says God will raise up for Israel a prophet like whom?
explanation: Israel must listen to him. “The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.” (Deuteronomy 18:15, BSB)

content: In the Song of Moses, God caring for Israel is compared to what bird stirring its nest?
explanation: God carried them on His wings. “As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young” (Deuteronomy 32:11, BSB)

content: In Deuteronomy, where did Moses tell the Levites to place the Book of the Law?
explanation: It would stand as a witness. “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God” (Deuteronomy 31:26, BSB)
